bombay-2003.notes: Source 1 crawl is mostly the IIT Bombay CSE department site; its seed is the 2004 problem set page and it also holds a 2004 blog. Source 2/3/4 tables: the Preliminary Site table has 34 placed teams and 92 Honorable Mention rows. The unlabelled number column in sources 2 and 3 matches the solved counts on the organisers' final results page.

sources.evidence: Crawl whose pages include the 2003 subsite (home page reading ACM ICPC 2003 - Asia Regional Site at IIT Bombay December 6 and 7, 2003, teams, final results, preliminary contest).

bombay-2004.notes: Source 6 lists 130 preliminary-round teams, while the website's results page says over 135 registered; the preliminary page says over 130 took part. Source 3's two preliminary tables are labelled by the page as W. Nationwide Preliminaries and Foreign Teams.
